result.title: GradReason: LLMs as Meta-Learners that Replace Training Epochs with Training-Data-Free Weight Updates
result.summary: Standard training recipes make a fixed number of passes over the training data, even when an epoch mostly adds mini-batch noise. We study whether a large language model (LLM) that reads the weight and gradient history of a run can replace some of these epochs with updates that compute no gradient and read no training image. In GradReason, an LLM agent is called every ten epochs. In a restricted sandbox, it analyses recent weight snapshots, epoch-mean gradients, and validation metrics, then submits a Python program that computes new weights and a plan marking each of the next ten epochs as data or virtual. A virtual epoch is kept only if it passes a forward-only check on 5,000 held-out validation images. In 120 runs on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 with three architectures, Claude Opus 5.5 used 32.8% fewer data epochs than the 80-epoch recipe at 0.31 percentage points lower test accuracy (95% CI -0.72 to +0.09; 0.94 points on ResNet-18), on the recipe's own frontier of data against accuracy. Unprompted, Opus averaged recent weight snapshots in every run. This choice produced the savings: a fixed rule with the same acceptance check but extrapolations from prior work saved 5.4% of the data epochs, and the same rule with averaging added saved 25.0%. The LLM's contribution is to find a working update within a single run; once found, a fixed rule implements it equally well. An Opus run cost 0.68 USD, but at this scale the agent's latency exceeded the GPU time it saved.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 GradReason：每十个 epoch 调用一次 LLM，读取权重快照、epoch 平均梯度与验证指标，输出一段 Python 程序生成新权重并规划后续 epoch 为真实或「虚拟」，虚拟 epoch 需通过 5000 张留出图像的仅前向校验；在 CIFAR-10/100 上三种架构 120 次运行中减少约 33% 数据 epoch，但收益主要来自 LLM 自发采用的权重平均，固定规则同样能做到。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 VLM 推理主线不直接相关，可供核查的线索是「让 LLM 读取历史状态并生成状态更新与执行计划」这一机制，可能类比 LVR 中的 latent 状态更新与训练监督设计；其「找到规则后固定规则等效」的结论也提示此类 LLM 元决策的贡献分配需谨慎解读。
